definitions.explanation: Multiple locations, not just one specific place.
Many different places throughout an area.

examples.japanese: あちこち⟦{探|さが}しました→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。

examples.english: There are books all over the room.

examples.japanese: あちこち⟦{旅行|りょこう}しました→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧。
⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あちこち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧あちこち⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧⟦{見|み}つからなかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I searched all over for the cat but couldn't find it.

examples.japanese: あちこち⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あちこち⟦{出|で}かけます→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: On days off, I go out to various places.
There are shops all over town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あちこち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Various parts of the house have gotten old.

notes:
あちこち means "here and there" or "various places." It can function as either a noun or an adverb.

USAGE:
- As noun: あちこちに/で/を + verb
- As adverb: あちこち + verb (directly modifies the verb)

VARIATIONS:
- ⟦あちらこちら→あちらこちら：25969_achirakochira⟧: same meaning, slightly more formal or polite
- ⟦あっちこっち→あっちこっち：noentry⟧: same meaning, more casual

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あちこち⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to search here and there
- あちこち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散|ち}らばる→散らばる：12713_chirabaru⟧: scattered all over
- あちこち⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to walk around various places
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あちこち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: various parts of the body hurt

NOTE:
Part of the ko-so-a-do demonstrative system: ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧ (here) → ⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧ (there, far). あちこち combines あちら and こちら, conveying the idea of "this place and that place" — i.e., all over.
